target_api: dereference of a function parameter that is a pointer (`p->field` / `&p->field`) inside the parameter's owning function
post_operation: explicit NULL check on that same parameter executed BEFORE any dereference (e.g. `if (!p) return -EINVAL;`, `if (p == NULL) return ...;`, `BUG_ON(!p)`)
path_conditions: Inside rfkill_register(struct rfkill *rfkill), the parameter is first dereferenced at variable initialisation `struct device *dev = &rfkill->dev;`. Only two statements later does the `BUG_ON(!rfkill)` NULL check run. Any caller that passes NULL therefore triggers the dereference before the existence check can reject it; the check is unreachable on the failing path.
